# The Winter Lab
Department of Epidemiology and Biostatistics | College of Public Health | University of Georgia
:::

::: {.content-container}
## Active Research Areas

::: {layout-ncol=3 .feature-cards}

::: {.card}
### <i class="bi bi-globe-americas"></i> Seroprevalence Studies
Investigating immunity levels in vulnerable populations. Current models focus on tetanus seroprevalence among children in Ndola and Choma Districts, Zambia.

[Learn More &rarr;](projects.qmd)
:::

::: {.card}
### <i class="bi bi-activity"></i> Pathogen Dynamics
Utilizing R, ggplot2, and gtsummary to analyze the spread, control, and evolution of infectious diseases on the population level. 

[View Publications &rarr;](publications.qmd)
:::

::: {.card}
### <i class="bi bi-shield-plus"></i> Intervention Strategies
Evaluating the impact of vaccines and targeted public health interventions on localized outbreaks and systemic transmission.

[Opportunities &rarr;](#)
:::

:::
